claim: Coco Teams NG is a console for running a firm of AI members: you hire them onto a roster, give them roles, skills and step-by-step procedures, put them in teams on projects, and direct the work from one place.
Hire from a built-in catalogue of 1,199 entries: 71 ready-made members, 227 skills, 15 standard procedures, 367 tools and 3 knowledge bases.
Talk to a whole team at once: put members on a team, open one conversation, and get one composed answer that splits the work by role.
Projects keep a team, its conversation and its memory together, and can be shared with someone outside your workspace for 30 days.
Schedules run work on a timer, and a general assistant answers when you don't want to pick a member.
Runs on your own machine with one command and talks to any OpenAI-compatible model endpoint you choose.
Each member on a team answers with its own model call, instead of one call for the whole team.
Search across projects, documents and conversations, not just members, teams and the catalogue.
Private beta: version 0.10.0 (released 26 October 2026) with 114 of 150 user journeys working and checked.
The next build round is planned for December 2026. No public launch date is set yet.
